The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''4085 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''', also known as the year '''432 before the Treaty of Coruscant (BTC)''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[Post-Manderon period|era]] between the [[Manderon Period]] and the [[Old Sith Wars]]. That year, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] produced a vintage of wine that, following the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], was known as 432 BTC. The vintage was a particularly rare and valuable one.
